#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Cron may invoke this script from an arbitrary working directory.  Keep the
# archive next to the logs directory rather than depending on cron's cwd.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "logs directory not found: $SCRIPT_DIR/logs" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
mockdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$mockdir"; rm -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"' EXIT
cat > "$mockdir/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS"
EOF
chmod +x "$mockdir/scp"
args=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -rf "$mockdir"; rm -f "$args" "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"' EXIT
(
  cd /tmp
  PATH="$mockdir:$PATH" SCP_ARGS="$args" /work/backup.sh
)
printf '%s\n' '--- archive ---'
tar -tzf "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
printf '%s\n' '--- scp arguments ---'
cat "$args"
